title: The hat
statementMd:
**This is an interactive problem.**

Imur Ishakov decided to organize a club for people who love to play the famous game «The hat». The club was visited by $*n*$ students, where $*n*$ is even. Imur arranged them all in a circle and held a draw to break the students in pairs, but something went wrong. The participants are numbered so that participant $*i*$ and participant $*i* + 1$ ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n* - 1$) are adjacent, as well as participant $*n*$ and participant $1$. Each student was given a piece of paper with a number in such a way, that for every two adjacent students, these numbers differ exactly by one. The plan was to form students with the same numbers in a pair, but it turned out that not all numbers appeared exactly twice.

As you know, the most convenient is to explain the words to the partner when he is sitting exactly across you. Students with numbers $*i*$ and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bb70c692e73bcdcab618b5caa2269589ff959700.png) sit across each other. Imur is wondering if there are two people sitting across each other with the same numbers given. Help him to find such pair of people if it exists.

You can ask questions of form «which number was received by student $*i*$?», and the goal is to determine whether the desired pair exists in no more than $60$ questions.

## Input

At the beginning the even integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) is given — the total number of students.

You are allowed to ask no more than $60$ questions.

## Output

To ask the question about the student $*i*$ ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$), you should print «`? i`». Then from standard output you can read the number $*a*_{*i*}$ received by student $*i*$ ($- 10^{9} ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$).

When you find the desired pair, you should print «`! i`», where $*i*$ is any student who belongs to the pair ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$). If you determined that such pair doesn't exist, you should output «`! -1`». In both cases you should immediately terminate the program.

The query that contains your answer is not counted towards the limit of $60$ queries.

Please make sure to flush the standard output after each command. For example, in C++ use function `fflush(stdout)`, in Java call `System.out.flush()`, in Pascal use `flush(output)` and `stdout.flush()` for Python language.

**Hacking**

Use the following format for hacking:

In the first line, print one even integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) — the total number of students.

In the second line print $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($- 10^{9} ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) separated by spaces, where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the number to give to $*i*$-th student. Any two adjacent elements, including $*n*$ and $1$, must differ by $1$ or $- 1$.

The hacked solution will not have direct access to the sequence $*a*_{*i*}$.

## Note

Input-output in statements illustrates example interaction.

In the first sample the selected sequence is $1, 2, 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2$

In the second sample the selection sequence is $1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 0$.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
**这是一道交互题。**

伊穆尔·伊沙科夫决定为喜欢玩著名游戏“帽子”的人组织一个俱乐部。俱乐部来了 $*n*$ 名学生，其中 $*n*$ 为偶数。伊穆尔将他们围成一圈，并通过抽签将学生两两配对，但事情出了差错。学生被编号，使得学生 $*i*$ 和学生 $*i* + 1$（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n* - 1$）相邻，同时学生 $*n*$ 和学生 $1$ 也相邻。每位学生都拿到了一张写有一个数字的纸条，使得任意两个相邻学生的数字恰好相差一。原计划是将数字相同的学生配成一对，但后来发现并非所有数字都恰好出现两次。

众所周知，当搭档正好坐在自己正对面时，向搭档解释单词是最方便的。持有数字 $*i*$ 的学生与 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bb70c692e73bcdcab618b5caa2269589ff959700.png) 的学生正好相对而坐。伊穆尔想知道是否存在两个正对面而坐且持有相同数字的人。请帮助他在存在时找出这样的一对人。

你可以询问“学生 $*i*$ 拿到的数字是多少？”，目标是在不超过 $60$ 次询问内确定是否存在所需的配对。

## 输入

一开始给出一个偶数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$）——学生总数。

你最多可以询问 $60$ 次。

## 输出

若要询问学生 $*i*$ 的情况（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$），应输出“`? i`”。随后可以从标准输出中读入学生 $*i*$ 拿到的数字 $*a*_{*i*}$（$- 10^{9} ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）。

当你找到所需的一对学生时，应输出“`! i`”，其中 $*i*$ 是属于该配对的任意一名学生（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）。如果你确定不存在这样的配对，则应输出“`! -1`”。在这两种情况下，都应立即终止程序。

包含答案的询问不计入 $60$ 次询问的限制。

请务必在每次输出命令后刷新标准输出。例如，在 C++ 中使用函数 `fflush(stdout)`，在 Java 中调用 `System.out.flush()`，在 Pascal 中使用 `flush(output)`，在 Python 中使用 `stdout.flush()`。

**黑客测试**

黑客测试时请使用以下格式：

第一行输出一个偶数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$）——学生总数。

第二行输出 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$- 10^{9} ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），用空格分隔，其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 是给第 $*i*$ 名学生的数字。任意两个相邻元素（包括 $*n*$ 和 $1$）之差必须为 $1$ 或 $- 1$。

被黑客测试的程序将无法直接访问序列 $*a*_{*i*}$。

## 说明

题面中的输入输出展示了一个交互示例。

在第一个样例中，选出的序列为 $1, 2, 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2$

在第二个样例中，选出的序列为 $1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 0$。
</statement>
